bridge_download_http: The model download was refused by the server.
bridge_download_no_space: Not enough free space for this model.
bridge_download_rename: The downloaded model could not be saved.
bridge_import_busy: A model import is already running.
bridge_import_move_failed: The imported model could not be saved.
bridge_import_not_gguf: That file is not a GGUF model.
bridge_import_open_failed: The selected file could not be opened.
bridge_model_load_failed: The on-device model could not be loaded.
bridge_ppocr_destroyed: The text detector was reset — try again.
bridge_ppocr_unavailable: This diagnostic is available only in debug builds.
bridge_unload_failed: The on-device model could not be unloaded.
catalog_all_translated_pages_will: All translated pages will be revised with these instructions. Original translations are preserved.
catalog_complete_recovered_books_stored: Complete recovered books stored on this device
catalog_confirm_clear_translations: Are you sure you want to clear all translation data for {name}? This will remove all regions, translations, and overlay data. The volume itself will be kept.
catalog_confirm_delete_named: Are you sure you want to delete {name}?
catalog_confirm_delete_volume: Are you sure you want to delete {name}? This will remove all pages, translations, and regions.

match.nPlural=one: This will permanently remove {n} volume and all its translations.
match.nPlural=other: This will permanently remove {n} volumes and all their translations.

match.direction=rtl: Follows the app setting in Settings → Display (currently right to left), and changes with it.
match.direction=ltr: Follows the app setting in Settings → Display (currently left to right), and changes with it.
match.direction=*: Follows the app setting in Settings → Display, and changes with it.

catalog_dismiss_and_don_t: Dismiss and don't show this warning again
catalog_e_g_the_main: e.g., "The main character is female — fix all pronouns" or "Use a more casual tone throughout"
catalog_each_page_translated_independent: Each page translated independently — no context between pages, no review pass.

match.others=yes: Import a .zip, .cbz, .cbr, or .pdf file, or browse your other libraries

catalog_import_a_zip_cbz: Import a .zip, .cbz, .cbr, or .pdf file to get started
catalog_invalid_page_range: Invalid range. Start must be ≤ end, both between 1 and {max}.
catalog_no_libraries_configured_add: No libraries configured. Add one in Settings.
catalog_no_subfolders_use_new: No subfolders. Use "+ New Folder" to create one.
catalog_no_volumes_match_the: No volumes match the current filters
catalog_one_or_more_library: One or more library folders are not accessible. Check Settings to update paths.
catalog_pinned_for_this_comic: Pinned for this comic only, ignoring the app setting. Manga reads right-to-left; western comics left-to-right.
catalog_provide_an_official_story: Provide an official story summary to help maintain narrative context...
catalog_remote_libraries_cannot_be: Remote libraries cannot be deleted from here
catalog_run_pp_ocr_text: Run PP-OCR text detection and generate overlay data for each page. Slower but allows translated text to be displayed directly over the manga.
catalog_skip_the_quality_review: Skip the quality review pass (Pass 2). Halves API cost and time but may reduce translation accuracy and character attribution.
catalog_this_removes_the_archives: This removes the archives and every translation, region, and reading position stored for them. It cannot be undone.
catalog_translates_with_rolling_story: Translates with rolling story context and a review pass for quality.
catalog_translation_complete_leftover_pa: Translation complete — {leftover} page{s} could not be translated. Run it again to retry just those.
conn_credentials_hint_kavita: Check the API key: Kavita → Settings → Account → API Key.
conn_credentials_hint_komga: Check the Komga username and password — they are the same ones you use in the browser.
conn_credentials_hint_yacreader: YACReaderLibraryServer connections are unauthenticated — an authorization error usually means something else (like a reverse proxy) answered.
conn_dns: The address {host} could not be found.
conn_dns_hint: Check the hostname for typos. On a local network, try the server's IP address instead.
conn_form_bad_port: The port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
conn_form_kavita_key: API key is required for Kavita.
conn_form_komga_credentials: Username and password are required for Komga.
conn_form_no_libraries: Connected, but no libraries found on the server.
conn_form_save_failed: The server was reachable, but its credentials could not be saved.
conn_form_save_failed_hint: Restart the app and try again. Do not re-enter other keys until saved credentials read correctly.
conn_generic: Could not connect to the {server} server.
conn_not_found: {host} answered, but no {server} server was found at this path.
conn_not_found_hint: If the server sits behind a reverse proxy, set the base path (for example /komga) under Advanced.
conn_timeout_hint: The server may be starting up, overloaded, or behind a firewall that drops this port.
conn_tls_hint: If the server has no valid HTTPS certificate, turn "Use HTTPS" off — or fix the certificate if it is exposed to the internet.
conn_unreachable_hint: Check the address and port, that the server is running, and that this device is on the same network (or VPN) as the server.
conn_wrong_server: {host} answered, but not like a {server} server.
conn_wrong_server_hint: Something else may be listening on this port — double-check the port and base path.
error_auth: Sign-in failed. Check the server credentials in Settings.
error_not_found: Not found on the server — it may have been moved or removed.

match.minutesPlural=one: Rate limited — the server requested a wait of {minutes} minute. Please try again later.
match.minutesPlural=other: Rate limited — the server requested a wait of {minutes} minutes. Please try again later.

error_rate_limited_short: Rate limited. Please wait a moment and try again.
error_server: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
error_timeout: The server took too long to respond. Try again in a moment.
error_unreachable: Can't reach the server. Check that it's running and that this device is on the same network.
header_click_individual_boxes_to: Click individual boxes to resize and customize
header_create_overlays_when_a: Create overlays when a newly opened page has none
header_enable_preserve_vertical_source: Enable Preserve vertical source orientation to use Vertical overrides
header_enable_translation_overlays_in: Enable translation overlays in Settings first
header_long_press_an_overlay: Long-press an overlay to move or resize it directly
header_long_strip_mode_scrolls: Long Strip mode scrolls — page turning doesn't apply.
header_toggle_vertical_horizontal_text: Toggle vertical/horizontal text on all boxes
help_0_7_0_starts_fresh: 0.7.0 starts fresh: the app's internal storage moved to a new home, so libraries, reading progress, and saved provider keys from earlier versions need re-importing and re-entering
help_a_bubble_detection_model: A bubble-detection model finds speech balloon boundaries and translated text is fitted cleanly inside each one. Text outside bubbles (signs, narration) gets auto-sized boxes.
help_a_local_comics_library: A "Local Comics" library is automatically created on your device. Copy comic files (.cbz, .zip, .pdf) to your device's comics folder using a file manager or USB, then tap "Scan" to import them. You can also tap "+ Import" in the library toolbar to select files directly.
help_add_a_small_amount: Add a small amount of credit under Credits. OpenRouter is pay-per-use with no subscription; unused credit keeps.
help_after_translating_a_volume: After translating a volume, long-press it in the catalog and tap "Export Translated CBZ" to save a new CBZ file with the translation overlay baked into every page image. Useful for sharing or reading in other apps.
help_all_your_data_imported: All your data — imported comics, translations, settings, and reading progress — is stored locally on your device in the app's private storage. Nothing is sent to external servers unless you explicitly configure it.
help_api_keys_you_enter: API keys you enter for translation providers are encrypted locally on your device using AES-256-GCM encryption. They are never transmitted anywhere except to the provider you configured.
help_app_speaks_your_language: The app speaks your language: the entire interface is now available in German, Spanish, French, Indonesian, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian. Pick a language under Settings → User interface — manga translation keeps its own separate target language.
help_as_a_rough_order: As a rough order of magnitude with an inexpensive vision model (like the default Gemini Flash class): a typical manga page costs a fraction of a cent, and a full ~200-page volume usually lands in the tens-of-cents range. Frontier models can cost 10× or more. The model picker in Settings → Translation shows live per-token prices for every model.
help_best_results_come_from: Best results come from off-device vision translation — the LLM sees the actual comic page image and translates directly, understanding visual context like speech bubbles, SFX, and panel flow.
help_boxes_sheet_blurb: {boxesOnThisPageMenu} in the globe menu lists every box on the page, including hidden and deleted ones, with what happened to it (placed, shrunk to fit, tap-to-reveal, not placed and why) and the actions Edit, Hide/Show, Reset to automatic, Delete/Restore. It works in long-strip mode too, where the page itself cannot be edited.
help_catalog_view_in_grid: Catalog view in grid mode with volume cards
help_choose_auto_horizontal_or: Choose Auto, Horizontal, or Vertical writing mode per box (Vertical is dormant while source-orientation preservation is off)
help_choose_from_12_color: Choose from 12 color schemes (6 dark, 6 light) in Settings → Display to personalize the app's appearance.
help_cleaner_library_comic_names: Cleaner library: comic names on the cover, a centered actions menu, and a refreshed app icon.
help_connect_to_a_self: Connect to a self-hosted library server (YACReader, Komga, or Kavita) that you configure
help_could_not_load_the: Could not load the notices file.
help_custom_on_device_model: Custom on-device model: point Fumeto at your own GGUF from device storage. Models other than the bundled ones are largely untested, and one whose chat format isn't recognised can be given a prompt format by hand.
help_delete_a_box_li: Delete a box. Nothing asks you to confirm: every edit — a move, a resize, a hide, a delete, a saved text — offers {undo} in a bar above the dock for a few seconds
help_deleting_model_li: Deleting a model: only frees its download; it can always be re-downloaded.
help_dialogue_is_never_dropped: Dialogue is never dropped from a page: text shrinks in steps and, as a last resort, becomes a tap-to-reveal balloon.
help_download_the_on_device: Download the on-device Hy-MT2 1.8B translation model
help_drawn_sound_effects_are: Drawn sound effects are left untranslated by default, like most official releases. To render their translations on the page, enable "Sound-effect overlays" in the reader's globe menu or the matching toggle in Settings → Overlay.
help_each_revision_creates_a: Each revision creates a new record; the most recent is always displayed. Previous versions are preserved in the database.
help_edits_survive_blurb: Boxes you customize are protected from being overwritten when overlay settings change, and they survive {reTranslatePage}: an edit is carried onto the new translation wherever the same text is detected again. An edit whose text is no longer detected is kept in the box list under “Edits that no longer match a box” until you discard it, and comes back by itself if a later run finds the text again.
help_enable_keep_translating_in: Enable "Keep translating in background" in Settings → Translation to continue batch translation when the app is minimized or the screen is off. A notification shows progress and includes a Cancel button.
help_erase_rescan_li: Erase Data & Rescan: the same deletion, followed by a fresh import of the folder.
help_everything_imported_comics_translat: Everything — imported comics, translations, reading progress, settings — is stored in this app's private storage on the device. It is removed only if you uninstall the app or clear its data.
help_fig_asks_the_model_to: Asks the model to improve the existing translation with your instructions — non-destructive: every revision is kept and can be switched back.
help_fig_auto_fits_the_whole: Auto fits the whole page, Width/Height fit one axis, and 1:1 shows actual pixels. You can also pinch-zoom and double-tap the page. Greyed out in Long Strip mode, which is always fit-width.
help_fig_discards_the_current_page: Discards the current page translation and runs a fresh one with your current provider and settings.
help_fig_how_pages_turn_in: How pages turn in Paged mode: horizontal Swipe, edge Tap, or Both. Not used in Long Strip mode — you just scroll.
help_fig_jumps_to_the_full: Jumps to the full Settings dialog.
help_fig_keeps_overlays_vertical_where: Keeps overlays vertical where the original Japanese text runs vertically, instead of converting everything to horizontal.
help_fig_leaves_the_reader_and: Leaves the reader and opens the Tabs view — comics you keep open for quick switching. Long-press a comic in the library and choose "Open in New Tab" to add one.
help_fig_lets_you_draw_boxes: Lets you draw boxes over specific text the detector missed, then translate just those. Needs Paged reader mode.
help_fig_opens_the_reader_menu: Opens the reader menu with zoom presets, reading direction, reader mode (Paged / Long Strip), page-turn style, and a Settings shortcut.
help_fig_opens_the_translation_menu: Opens the translation menu: auto-translate, vertical text, sound-effect overlays, re-translate, revisions, and region selection.
help_fig_opens_this_help_section: Opens this Help section, focused on the Translations chapter.
help_fig_per_comic_actions_open: Per-comic actions: Open in New Tab, Get Full Translation, Revise Translation, Mark as Translated, Export Translated CBZ, Edit Details, and Delete.
help_fig_returns_to_wherever_you: Returns to wherever you opened the comic from — the library or the Tabs view. Android Back does the same (after closing any open menus first).
help_fig_right_to_left_manga: Right-to-left (manga standard) or left-to-right. Controls which side turns forward and becomes the default for new volumes.
help_fig_shows_or_hides_overlay: Shows or hides overlay boxes for drawn sound effects (rumble, slam, footsteps…). Off keeps the artwork clean; dialogue and narration are never affected.
help_fig_shows_or_hides_the: Shows or hides the translated overlay boxes on the page. Teal means overlays are visible. Handy for quickly comparing against the original artwork.
help_fig_shows_page_count_and: Shows page count and reading progress underneath the cover.
help_fig_shows_the_current_volume: Shows the current volume. Long-press it to open the volume info dialog with file details.
help_fig_shows_your_position_tap: Shows your position. Tap to open the page filmstrip for scrubbing with thumbnails; long-press to type an exact page number.
help_fig_switches_between_paged_one: Switches between Paged (one page at a time with pan/zoom) and Long Strip (every page in one continuous vertical scroll with no gaps). In Long Strip the current page follows whatever fills most of the screen.
help_fig_tap_any_control_in: Tap any control in the mock-up above to see what it does.
help_fig_tap_to_start_reading: Tap to start reading (resumes your last page). Long-press for quick actions like Open in New Tab.
help_fig_the_comic_title_rides: The comic title rides a thin strip across the top of the cover, so long titles never crowd the card. Library cards in the All Libraries view use the same strip.
help_fig_translates_the_current_page: Translates the current page. While running it becomes a cancel button with a progress ring; when finished it shows Done, or a red Failed pill you can tap for details. A red Layout Failed pill means the translation was saved but its overlay could not be laid out; tapping it translates the page again. Long-press toggles automatic translation for every page ("(Auto)").
help_fig_when_on_any_page: When on, any page you open that has no overlays yet is translated automatically. Same switch as long-pressing the Translate button.
help_filter_volumes_by_tags: Filter volumes by tags if volumes have tags assigned.
help_fix_single_box_li: Fix a single box: long-press the box and tap Edit to change its text yourself. LLM re-revision runs at page scope on mobile (per-entry revision is available in the desktop side panel).
help_folder_context_menu_and: Folder context menu and folder creation
help_fully_translated_page_with: Fully translated page with overlay boxes
help_guided_region_translation_draw: Guided region translation: draw regions from the globe menu, then translate or adjust them from the review strip.
help_hy_mt2_blurb: {hyMt218b} — Tencent's translation-focused model in the mobile-oriented 1.25-bit STQ quant. The official GGUF is about 440 MiB and runs locally through the app's custom llama.cpp runtime.
help_in_paged_mode_pinch: In Paged mode: pinch to zoom, drag to pan, double-tap the center of the page to fit-to-screen. Long Strip is always fit-width.
help_in_paged_mode_swipe: In Paged mode, swipe left or right to change pages; in Tap or Both page-turn mode, tap the left/right third to turn. A single tap in the middle third toggles the top and bottom controls. Reading direction defaults to RTL (right-to-left, standard for manga). Tap the page counter to open a thumbnail filmstrip above the bottom bar — tap a thumbnail to jump while scrubbing, and tap anywhere else to close it. Long-press the page counter (or the filmstrip) for a numeric go-to-page dialog. After a long jump, a temporary Return chip takes you back.
help_interactive_help_tap_the: Interactive Help: tap the mock-ups in this Help section to learn each control.
help_intro: {app} is a comic reader and manga translation app for Android.
help_key_like_password: Treat the key like a password: it can spend your OpenRouter credit. {app} stores it encrypted on this device and only ever sends it to OpenRouter.
help_keywords_getting_started: setup, first, import, add library, remote
help_keywords_library_view: catalog, search, sort, folders, tags, move
help_keywords_reader_view: pages, zoom, navigation, regions, draw, controls, filmstrip, go to page, long-press, info
help_keywords_storage_data: backup, export, delete, files, space, where
help_keywords_tips: problem, error, connection, slow, faq, fix
help_keywords_translations: openrouter, api key, provider, on-device, modes, overlay, revisions, cost, price
help_library_polish_library_names: Library polish: library names ride a title strip on the All Libraries cards, and closing a tab animates the remaining tabs into place.
help_local_servers_run_the: Local servers run the LLM on your own hardware — free but requires a capable GPU.
help_long_press_the_reader: Long-press the reader title for comic details.
help_long_strip_reader_mode: Long Strip reader mode: read top-down in one continuous scroll with no page breaks. Switch modes from the reader's ⋮ menu or Settings → Display; the current page follows whatever fills the screen, and translation works exactly as in Paged mode.
help_main_catalog_view_with: Main catalog view with a library loaded
help_manga_v4_on_device_model: Manga v4 on-device model: a new fine-tune available in Settings → Translation → On-Device, matching v2's Japanese → English quality with better multilingual behaviour.
help_mode_1_li: {mode1Isolated} — Translates only the highlighted section. Fastest, no context.
help_mode_2_3_add: Mode 2/3 add context text — slightly more input tokens, usually worth it.
help_mode_2_li: {mode2PageContext} — Includes context from other translations on this page. Produces more consistent character names and terminology.
help_mode_3_li: {mode3FullContext} — Includes context from the entire work's translations — a rolling summary of previous pages plus all translations on the current page. Best for maintaining narrative consistency across an entire volume.
help_navigate_into_subfolders_via: Navigate into subfolders via folder cards. Breadcrumbs show the current path. Folder management options (create, rename, delete) are available via the "+ Folder" button or long-press on folder cards.
help_new_remote_server_form: New remote-server form with separate address/port/HTTPS fields, clearer errors, and connection editing without losing translations.
help_off_device_cloud_llms: Off-device cloud LLMs (recommended: a vision-enabled model like Gemini 3 Flash or Qwen3.5 via OpenRouter)
help_off_device_li: {offDevice} — Sends images or text to a cloud/remote LLM. More powerful, requires API key or local server.
help_off_device_translation_is: Off-device translation is pay-per-use through your own API key; the app itself adds nothing. A vision request sends the page image plus a prompt and receives the translations back.
help_on_device_li: {onDevice} — Runs entirely on your device. No internet needed, but lower quality.
help_on_device_speed_from_cores: Snappier on-device translation: the translator now sizes itself to your device's fast CPU cores, which makes it quicker and steadier on many phones and tablets.
help_on_device_translation_is: On-device translation is free and offline — at lower quality.
help_on_mobile_long_press: On mobile, long-press a visible translated box to show its resize outline, offset move handle, and the Edit / Delete / Show-original actions stacked under the handle; drag a handle and release to save immediately. Edit opens the detailed, accessible editor for TalkBack, keyboard, text changes, and destructive actions. Detailed changes auto-save on close, outside tap, Back, or page change. You can:
help_open_openrouter_li: Open <link name="openrouter">openrouter.ai</link> and create a free account (email or Google/GitHub sign-in).
help_open_settings_libraries_tab: Open Settings → Libraries tab → tap "+ Remote" → select server type (YACReader, Komga, or Kavita) → enter server URL and credentials → tap "Test" to verify connection → Save.
help_open_the_globe_menu: Open the globe menu and tap "Select regions…". Draw one or more rectangles with one finger; every valid rectangle is saved immediately. Use two fingers to pan or pinch without creating a region. Undo removes only the newest region from this draw session. Done opens the review strip in the bottom bar — Translate the new regions, add translated ones to the overlay, clear them, or tap an individual region for its own Translate/Delete popover.
help_open_the_reader_s: Open the reader's globe menu → "Select regions…" → draw one or more rectangles → Done. The review strip in the bottom bar can translate the new regions or add translated ones to the overlay, and tapping an individual region offers its own Translate/Delete popover.
help_openrouter_provides_access_to: OpenRouter provides access to many LLMs including Gemini Flash (recommended for manga translation).
help_openrouter_setup_path: Settings → Translation → Off-Device → tap the default provider or add new → set Type to "OpenRouter" → enter your OpenRouter API key → select a vision-capable model (default: {defaultOpenrouterModel}).
help_overlay_box_selected_for: Overlay box selected for editing with controls
help_overlay_text_size_has: Overlay text size has a remembered global default alongside per-volume adjustment.
help_pay_per_use_via: Pay-per-use via OpenRouter. Vision models cost more per request but produce significantly better translations.
help_perm_foreground_li: Foreground Service: Used to keep batch translations running when the app is in the background.
help_perm_internet_li: Internet: Required for connecting to your configured library servers, model hosts, and translation providers.
help_perm_notifications_li: Notifications: Shows translation progress when running in the background.
help_perm_wake_lock_li: Wake Lock: Prevents the device from sleeping during long-running batch translations.
help_persian_is_selectable_as: Persian is selectable as an on-device target language, and Chinese (Simplified) is now named correctly in the translation prompt.
help_pp_ocrv6_is_the: PP-OCRv6 is the default OCR provider for on-device translation.
help_pp_ocrv6_native_onnx: PP-OCRv6 — native ONNX Runtime on Android, with a cross-platform WebAssembly fallback.
help_privacy_no_collection: {app} does not collect, transmit, or store personal data, usage analytics, advertising identifiers, or telemetry. No advertising, analytics, crash-reporting, or tracking SDK is bundled with the app.
help_privacy_note_in_vision: Privacy note: in vision mode the page images themselves are sent to the provider you configured. Use On-Device translation if pages must never leave the device.
help_provider_claude_li: Anthropic Claude: Set Type to "Anthropic Claude", enter your Anthropic API key. Supports vision translation.
help_provider_lmstudio_li: LM Studio: Set Type to "LM Studio", enter server URL. Same text-only pipeline as Ollama.
help_provider_ollama_li: Ollama: Set Type to "Ollama", enter your Ollama server URL (e.g., http://localhost:11434). No API key needed. Uses text-only pipeline — PP-OCR extracts text on-device first, then sends text to Ollama for translation.
help_provider_openai_li: OpenAI-compatible: Set Type to "OpenAI-compatible", enter base URL and API key. Works with OpenAI, Together AI, Fireworks, and other compatible providers. Vision support depends on the chosen model.
help_reader_modes_text: {paged} shows one page at a time with pan and zoom. {longStrip} stacks every page in one continuous top-down scroll with no gaps between pages — the current page (for the counter, progress, and translation) follows whichever page fills most of the screen. Switch in the ⋮ menu or Settings → Display. In Long Strip, zoom presets, Swipe/Tap page turning, and region drawing are greyed out; scrolling is the navigation.
help_reader_view_showing_a: Reader view showing a comic page
help_redesigned_reader_the_expandable: Redesigned reader: the expandable bottom panel is gone. Translate directly from the bottom bar, browse pages in a thumbnail filmstrip, long-press the page counter for go-to-page, and edit boxes right on the page (Edit / Delete / Show original).
help_redesigned_settings_changes_apply: Redesigned Settings: changes apply instantly, a search box finds any option, and overlay options moved to their own tab.
help_region_drawing_mode_with: Region drawing mode with a drawn rectangle
help_remove_library_li: Remove (library): permanently deletes that library's imported entries, translations, regions, and progress after a confirmation. Your comic files and server content are untouched.
help_resize_the_box_using: Resize the box using corner handles
help_results_display_as_an: Results display as an overlay on top of the comic page, with translated text positioned over the original.
help_revise_page_li: Revise a page: Tap "Revise page…" in the reader's globe menu to re-examine all translations on the current page.
help_revise_volume_li: Revise an entire volume: Use the "Revise Translation" option in the volume's context menu (in the catalog view) to re-review all translated pages for consistency and accuracy.
help_runs_entirely_on_your: Runs entirely on your device with no internet connection required.
help_sample_pages_credit: Sample manga pages: {title} — {author}, reproduced under the author's free secondary-use terms.
help_screenshots_credit: Screenshots throughout this guide use {title} by {author}, published for free secondary use.
help_screenshots_english_note: The screenshots in this guide show the English interface; the controls are in the same places.
help_search_bar_open_with: Search bar open with filtered results
help_see_the_translations_section: See the "Translations" section below for a complete guide on configuring translation providers.
help_selection_mode_with_two: Selection mode with two volumes checked and the Move action
help_send_translation_requests_to: Send translation requests to an LLM provider (e.g., OpenRouter) that you configure with your own API key
help_settings_backup_export_and: Settings backup: export and import your configuration as JSON (keys and passwords excluded).
help_settings_libraries_settings_backup: Settings → Libraries → Settings Backup exports your configuration as JSON (API keys and passwords are never included). Comics and translations are not part of the export; to keep a translated volume, use "Export Translated CBZ" from the volume's menu.
help_settings_libraries_tab_with: Settings Libraries tab with the add-remote-server form
help_settings_overlay_enable_disable: Settings → Overlay: enable/disable overlays, set the overlay text size, preserve vertical source orientation when wanted, and enable auto-generation during batch translation. Turning preservation off makes every translated box horizontal without deleting saved per-box Vertical overrides.
help_settings_showing_the_three: Settings showing the three translation mode options
help_settings_translation_on_device: Settings → Translation → On-Device → pick a model and tap "Download". The Standard Translation Model (462 MB, 1.25-bit) suits tight storage. Both fine-tunes are ~1.13 GB Q4_K_M and run at a similar speed: v2 is the strongest at Japanese → English but is worse than the standard model at every other language pair, and v3 matches it on Japanese → English while keeping the other languages intact — pick v3 unless you only ever translate into English. You can also point the app at your own GGUF from device storage, though other models are largely untested. The model runs locally after download.
help_settings_translation_tab_showing: Settings Translation tab showing an OpenRouter provider
help_settings_translation_tab_showing_2: Settings Translation tab showing the on-device backend options
help_sharper_text_detection_on: Sharper text detection on large pages; batch translation reliability fixes.
help_sound_effects_now_stay: Sound effects now stay untranslated by default (official-release style) — flip "Overlay sound effects" in Settings → Overlay to translate them on-page again.
help_tap_any_volume_in: Tap any volume in the catalog to open the reader. Swipe to navigate pages, or pick Tap/Both under "Page turn" in the reader's ⋮ menu. Prefer continuous scrolling? Switch Reader mode to Long Strip there too.
help_tap_get_api_key: Tap "Get API Key" on the homepage (or open Keys from your account menu) and create a key. Copy it right away — it is only shown once.
help_tap_the_button_on: Tap the ⋮ button on a comic card (or long-press the card) to open its actions menu: Open in New Tab, Get Full Translation, Mark as Translated, Edit Details, Delete, and more. Tap Cancel or anywhere outside the menu to close it.
help_tap_the_checkmark_button: Tap the checkmark button → select volumes → tap "Move" → browse to destination folder → tap "Move Here".
help_tap_the_get_full: Tap the "Get Full Translation" button (in the volume's context menu) to translate every page automatically. This runs a two-pass process — first pass translates all pages sequentially, second pass reviews for consistency (the review pass can be disabled in Settings → Translation → "Skip Review Pass"). Translation is checkpointed after each page so it can resume if interrupted.
help_tap_the_search_icon: Tap the search icon to open the search bar. Search by volume title or by folder name (toggle search mode).
help_tap_the_sort_button: Tap the sort button — its icon shows the current field — to pick Date Added, Name, Last Read, or Number of Pages. The arrow button beside it flips between ascending and descending.
help_tap_the_translate_action: Tap the Translate action in the bottom bar. The run continues if you hide the chrome, open the keyboard, or briefly leave the reader without changing its target; the bar shows progress, and tapping it again cancels a cancellable run. Failures stay on the bar until you open and dismiss their details.
help_teal_balloon_li: Teal-tinted balloon — tap-to-reveal: the translation could not fit legibly, so tap the balloon to read it in a popover; tap again to dismiss.
help_the_app_is_ad: The app is ad-free and completely free — there are no in-app purchases or subscriptions.
help_the_app_only_connects: The app only connects to the internet when you:
help_the_bottom_bar_s: The bottom bar's Translate action starts a full-page translation directly (tap again to cancel a running one; failures open a details dialog). The page counter opens the thumbnail filmstrip, and a long-press on it opens the numeric go-to-page dialog. Translation toggles and page actions live in the globe menu; editing happens at the boxes themselves.
help_the_globe_menu_is: The globe menu is translation home base — explore it:
help_the_llm_receives_the: The LLM receives the actual comic page image and translates directly from the visual. Best accuracy — understands speech bubbles, SFX, reading order, and visual context.
help_the_openrouter_ai_homepage: The openrouter.ai homepage with its Get API Key button
help_the_review_pass_roughly: The review pass roughly doubles cost; "Skip review step" halves it back.
help_the_storage_card_and: The Storage card and On-Device Models list (Settings → Libraries) show what uses space; models can be deleted individually.
help_the_top_row_contains: The top row contains Back, the comic title, translated-overlay visibility, Translate options (globe), and More (⋮). Long-press the comic title to see its full name, file location, and other details. Opening any reader menu closes the others; tapping outside a menu dismisses it. The bottom row contains Tabs, the current page count (labeled Pages), and Translate — long-press Translate to toggle auto-translate. Explore both bars below:
help_the_whole_app_is: The whole app is free now — the Pro purchase is gone, and revision passes and translated CBZ export are open to everyone
help_third_party_blurb: Your personal data is never sold or shared by {app}. Network requests are sent only to library servers, model hosts, and translation providers that you choose; those services operate under their own privacy policies.
help_tip_background_li: Background translation: Enable "Keep translating in background" in Translation settings so batch translation continues when the screen is off.
help_tip_boxes_wrong_li: Overlay boxes look wrong? Long-press any box to reposition or resize it, tap its Edit action to change the text, or open “Boxes on this page…” in the globe menu to reset it to automatic placement. Your customizations are automatically preserved.
help_tip_cant_connect_li: Can't connect to your Komga/Kavita/YACReader server? Check that the phone is on the same network (or VPN) as the server, the port matches the server's (YACReader 8080, Komga 25600, Kavita 5000 by default), and HTTPS is only enabled if the server actually has a certificate. Behind a reverse proxy, set the base path (e.g. /komga) under Advanced in the server form.
help_tip_cant_see_li: Can't see overlay? Check the eye toggle in the reader's top bar, and make sure "Enable text overlays" is on in Settings → Overlay.
help_tip_interrupted_li: Translation interrupted? Batch translations are checkpointed — just re-run "Get Full Translation" and it will resume from where it stopped.
help_tip_quality_li: Translation quality: For the best manga translations, use a vision-enabled model like Gemini 3 Flash (Recommended) or Qwen3.5 via OpenRouter with Mode 2 (Page Context) or Mode 3 (Full Context).
help_tip_server_moved_li: Server moved or password changed? Use "Edit Connection" on the library card in Settings → Libraries — no need to remove the library or lose translations.
help_tip_slow_li: Slow on-device translation: Hy-MT2's 1.25-bit STQ runtime is designed for efficient mobile inference, but speed still varies with device CPU, available memory, page text density, and thermal throttling.
help_tip_text_size_li: All overlay text too large/small? Go to Settings → Overlay and adjust "Overlay Text Size". Per-box sizes can be tuned in each box's editor.
help_toggle_between_grid_view: Toggle between grid view (thumbnail cards) and list view (compact rows) using the view mode button in the toolbar.
help_translations_intro: {app} can translate manga and comics using cloud-based LLMs or on-device models. This section covers all translation options and how to use them.
help_translations_use_a_non: Translations use a non-destructive revision system — original translations are never deleted.
help_translucent_text_over_art: A lighter touch on artwork: text placed outside speech bubbles now sits on a translucent wash that lets the art show through and melts away at the edges, instead of an opaque white box — and its text block hugs the original lettering more tightly.
help_two_steps: {app} translates comics in two steps: (1) text detection/OCR identifies text in the image, (2) a translation model converts the text to your target language.
help_unplaced_marker_li: ! with a dashed outline — the item could not be placed; the box list names the reason.
help_upgraded_on_device_translation: Upgraded on-device translation model: the manga-tuned Hy-MT2 fine-tune (Q4_K_M) is selectable next to the standard model in Settings → Translation, and the Android model notification now names the variant that's loaded.
help_upgraded_translation_model_v3: Upgraded Translation Model v3: a second manga fine-tune that keeps Japanese → English at v2's level while restoring the other languages v2 lost — Simplified Chinese, Vietnamese, Italian, Indonesian, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian, Thai, Hindi, Farsi and Arabic. Pick it in Settings → Translation → On-Device. v2 stays available, and its card now says plainly what it is worse at.
help_use_the_library_dropdown: Use the library dropdown at the top of the catalog to switch between local and self-hosted remote libraries.
help_when_at_the_root: When at the root of a library, a horizontal scroll bar shows up to 25 recently read volumes.
help_yacreader_komga_and_kavita: YACReader, Komga, and Kavita libraries display their server-side folder hierarchy for browsing.
help_zoom_presets_reading_direction: Zoom presets, reading direction, reader mode, page-turn style, and a Settings shortcut live here:

Polish and Turkish regress slightly.
model_variant_manga_v4_description: Japanese to English only — the best of the fine-tunes for it. Trained on real recogniser output, so it holds up better on noisy OCR text, and less prone than v2 to flipping who does what to whom. Worse than the Standard model for every other language pair; same size and speed as v2.
